svg.title: The finished SmartDesign canvas in Libero, with numbered callouts: the APB master core, the CoreAPB3 block that joins it to the register core, the register core itself, the single bus line between CoreAPB3 and the register core, the clock and reset ports that feed both cores, and the AXI4-Stream port that leaves the design.
svg.desc: The finished SmartDesign canvas in Libero, with numbered callouts: the APB master core, the CoreAPB3 block that joins it to the register core, the register core itself, the single bus line between CoreAPB3 and the register core, the clock and reset ports that feed both cores, and the AXI4-Stream port that leaves the design.

g.text: The stand-in for the processor: its one bus interface is an APB initiator.
The vendor's APB fabric from the Catalog: master on the left, one slave slot on the right.
The core made in this module: APB_TARGET in, AXIS_INITIATOR out, PCLK and PRESETN as plain pins.
A bus interface is wired with a single connection, not nine.
PCLK and PRESETN are top-level ports wired to both cores.
AXIS_INITIATOR is promoted to a port of the design, ready for a receiver.
